req.title: Reject negative squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject negative squad numbers with an HTTP 422 response. This behavior needs to be validated through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_positive_squad_number
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid positive squad number.
expected: The response contains the created player data with the specified squad number.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27

tests.name: test_negative_squad_number
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a negative squad number.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": -1,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text

tests.name: test_boundary_squad_number_zero
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
